issue_candidates.title: Define multi-process and mid-write crash semantics for impact recording
issue_candidates.evidence: V4 verifies single-process append and retry recovery but does not lock concurrent writers or fault-inject a crash inside appendFileSync.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: V4 promises a local append-only proposal loop, not concurrent daemon writes or operating-system crash atomicity.

issue_candidates.title: Validate candidate patch applicability and semantics
issue_candidates.evidence: V4 validates one target file, canonical headers, a hunk, tracking, and digest; it does not apply every future patch during ledger validation.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Semantic evaluation belongs to the proposal eval and promotion stage; the V4 ledger records identity and evidence.
